alerts.title: US Level 2 advisory and embassy alert
alerts.body: State Department Level 2 (exercise increased caution) for terrorism and unrest, last updated Oct 21. US Embassy Paris issued a Nov 4 security alert on the Nov 5 nationwide strike and possible weekend demonstrations. Avoid demonstrations, crowds and police activity.

alerts.title: Vigipirate still elevated
alerts.body: National terror plan remains at Vigilance renforcee (intermediate level) across France.

alerts.title: Nov 5 national strike day — outcome
alerts.body: Interior Ministry: about 575,000 protesters nationwide (about 60,000 in Paris); CGT claimed near 1.6 million. Largely peaceful authorized marches; 448 arrests and 53 officers injured by 6pm, with clashes in cities such as Lyon. Rail and some schools disrupted that day; no new national interprofessional strike date confirmed afterward.

alerts.title: Nov 7 follow-on marches
alerts.body: Yellow-vest Acte IV called for Saturday afternoon actions, including a Concorde gathering from 2pm. SNES-FSU also called educators to join Saturday demos. CGT says mobilisation continues but has not set a new national strike day. Social conference with unions planned Mon Nov 9.

alerts.title: Nov 14 youth and yellow-vest actions
alerts.body: Yellow-vest coordination and youth/climate groups call Saturday Nov 14 actions (Acte V framing). Local routes may be declared closer to the date.

alerts.title: National retirees' march
alerts.body: Rally 11am at Montparnasse station area, march toward Les Invalides around 1pm.

alerts.title: European cost-of-living actions Nov 20-22
alerts.body: Housing and cost-of-living groups from several European countries called coordinated demonstrations Nov 20-22. French city routes not yet fully published.
